summary: Scanned model depth and a few optimizer hyperparameters under the fixed 5-minute budget, holding the nanochat-style architecture (value embeddings, sliding window attention, NorMuon+AdamW) fixed. Increasing DEPTH from 8 to 10 (deeper/narrower model, same ASPECT_RATIO) gave the only clear win: val_bpb 1.012347 -> 1.001799. DEPTH=12 either OOM'd at the default batch size or, after halving DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to fit, trained slower per step and ended up worse than both baseline and DEPTH=10, so 10 looks like a local sweet spot for this compute budget. Perturbing MATRIX_LR (0.04->0.05), WARMDOWN_RATIO (0.5->0.35), and WEIGHT_DECAY (0.2->0.1) around the DEPTH=10 config each gave results at or slightly worse than the DEPTH=10 baseline, within noise. Next things worth trying: a finer depth sweep (9, 11) with batch size kept at 128 if VRAM allows, or reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE at DEPTH=10-11 to get more optimizer steps per wall-clock second instead of just fitting a bigger model.
